identity.name: Wumpus Cave: Echoes of the Deep
identity.aesthetic: Dark Fantasy meets Retro-Terminal. High contrast, glowing accents on deep black backgrounds.
principles: Immersion First: The UI should feel like a survival tool found in the cave.
Visual Clarity: The grid must be readable despite the dark theme.
Feedback is Key: Every action (move, shoot) needs immediate visual/audio feedback.

usage.h1: font-heading text-4xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-primary-foreground
usage.h2: font-heading text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-muted-foreground

layout.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout.game_board: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 aspect-square bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(225,29,72,0.3)] transition-all duration-300 font-heading tracking-widest uppercase
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/20 text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/30 border border-secondary/50 backdrop-blur-md

cards.base: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-xl

grid_cell.base: aspect-square border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl transition-all duration-300 relative

steps: 1. Setup Global Styles: Update index.css with the font imports and base dark theme variables.
2. Create Layout Shell: Build the main App structure with the background texture and grid container.
3. Build Game Grid: Create the 8x8 grid component. Use CSS Grid. Ensure cells are square.
4. Implement Game Logic Visuals: Connect cell states (hidden, visited, current) to styles.
5. Add Controls & Stats: Build the sidebar with the D-Pad (for mobile/mouse users) and Stats panel.
6. Integrate Modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for 'Game Over' and 'Victory' screens.
7. Polish: Add the glow effects, transitions, and sound effect triggers (visual cues).
universal_rules: Use 'sonner' for all in-game notifications (e.g., 'You smell a wumpus!').
Ensure the grid is fully responsive. On mobile, it should take full width.
Do NOT use default scrollbars. Hide them or style them thin.
